title_vi: Phát hành ứng dụng di động: bảy bước của nguồn, điều tài liệu của hai cửa hàng xác nhận, và một mô hình phát hành theo pha

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a git fetch of the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

claims.evidence: Seven steps from the source body; Apple pages (phased release, TestFlight, Developer Program, App Review) and the Android Studio publish page fetched on 2026-10-19; Google Play Console pages were not reachable, so Android staged rollout and fees are not cross-checked. The phased-release table is a calculation (Python 3.13.16) from Apple's published schedule with stated assumptions, not a measurement on a store.

claims.claim_vi: Source: seven steps - registration and development (Apple Developer Program, Google Play Console; Swift/Obj-C, Java/Kotlin), build and test with a release candidate, QA (dogfooding, external beta, regression), internal approvals, app store optimization, submission (App Store Connect, Google Play Console), release on a chosen date.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Apple phased release: a version update can be released gradually over 7 days to a random sample of users with automatic updates - day 1 1%, 2 2%, 3 5%, 4 10%, 5 20%, 6 50%, 7 100%; users can still download it manually; the release can be paused up to 30 days in total; Release to All Users is possible at any time.
claims.section: Release a version update in phases

claims.claim_vi: Apple TestFlight: up to 100 internal testers (App Store Connect users) and up to 10,000 external testers; the first build for an external group goes to App Review; a build can be tested for up to 90 days; metrics include sessions and crashes.
Apple Developer Program costs 99 US dollars per year and includes TestFlight; Apple reviews all apps and app updates submitted to App Store Connect.
claims.section: Join the Apple Developer Program; App Review overview
claims.verified_by: Pages fetched and read on 2026-10-19 (developer.apple.com/programs/ and developer.apple.com/distribute/app-review/).

claims.claim_vi: Android Studio publishing guide: disable logging and set the release variant not debuggable; build and sign a release version; test it on at least one handset and one tablet; new apps must publish with the Android App Bundle from August 2021; the app goes live once it passes Google Play review.
claims.section: Prepare your app for release; Release on Google Play
claims.verified_by: Page fetched and read on 2026-10-19 (last updated 2023-11-15 per the page).

claims.claim_vi: Phased-release model: 1,000,000 eligible users, every selected user updates and uses the app that day, a bug crashes a share r of users, each crashed user reports with probability 0.5, the team halts the day cumulative reports reach 100: r=10% halts on day 1 with 10,000 users exposed; 1% on day 2 with 20,000; 0.1% on day 5 with 200,000; 0.01% never reaches 100 reports in 7 days.
claims.verified_by: Calculation by the author on 2026-10-19; a model with stated assumptions, not a measurement.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: bảy bước, điều tài liệu độc lập xác nhận, mô hình phát hành theo pha.
source_deviations: The source is a picture with seven steps; the lesson keeps the seven steps in order, adds a cross-check column and a calculation for the release step.
Google Play fees and staged rollout, internal approvals and ASO are not cross-checked; store review times are not estimated.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết tại repo này (gói W8), giữ ở trạng thái draft chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
